prerequisite: Use after compute_quantities recomputed the material lists (old lists cleared, new Guids) and every volume table in the drawing shows 0; first confirm the new list data itself is non-zero (export_material_volumes)
fixture_requirements: Both healthy volume tables (guid still points to a live list) and broken ones (alignments that were recomputed)
Broken tables belonging to two geographically separate alignments (verifies nearest-alignment assignment)
assertions: In-memory change only: results must be kept with an explicit save_dwg
Healthy tables are not touched at all (tables_healthy count, guid unchanged)
Dead tables get only MaterialListGuid and the selected materials replaced; position/style/layer are untouched
Re-selected materials = all materials of the new list (materials_selected >= 1; 0 needs a manual look)
Assignment picks the nearest alignment with a list by bounding-box centre; distance is always reported -- check manually when two alignments are close
No material list in the drawing throws and points to compute_quantities
After rebinding, rows extracted by export_all_dwg_tables should be non-zero (final acceptance criterion)
Idempotent: a second run reports tables_rebound == 0
